signal: Lambda raised over $1.5B Series E led by TWG Global and signed multi-billion-dollar GPU deals with Microsoft and Nvidia, heading toward an IPO in H2 2026

email.body1:
Erica, saw Lambda closed the $1.5B Series E and the big Microsoft and Nvidia commitments ahead of a possible IPO.

Growth that fast usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can route and action quickly, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Erica, quick follow-up for Lambda.

In RevOps the gap is rarely intent data, it is the latency between a signal firing and a rep actually touching the account. Manual research and writing add days, and by then the moment has passed.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and how to cut signal-to-action time. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Erica, last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lambda's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling infrastructure teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Erica, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right before an IPO the ops team is usually buried in cleanup and reporting.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Lambda either way.
